Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.mapping

Class DcatGenerator

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.mapping.DcatMappingBase
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.mapping.DcatGenerator
public class DcatGenerator extends DcatMappingBase
DcatGenerator creates the DCAT description of open metadata elements. A DeployedAPI asset is described as a dcat:DataService and a DataSet asset is described as a dcat:Dataset (or dcat:DatasetSeries) whose distributions are the assets that supply its data. Any other type of asset is described as a dcat:Dataset with a single distribution that describes how to get to the asset. A collection is described as a dcat:Catalog.

An element that was catalogued from a DCAT description is given back its original IRI and the properties that were kept in its additional properties. Other elements are identified by an IRI built from their unique identifier.

    • generateCatalog

      public DcatCatalog generateCatalog(String collectionGUID, List<DcatResource> members) throws InvalidParameterException, PropertyServerException, UserNotAuthorizedException
      Generate the DCAT description of a collection as a catalog. The members of the catalog are supplied by the caller, which decides which of the collection's members are to be published.
      Parameters:
      collectionGUID - unique identifier of the collection
      members - descriptions of the resources to list in the catalog
      Returns:
      catalog
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - the unique identifier is not known or is not for a collection.
      PropertyServerException - a problem retrieving information from the property server(s).
      UserNotAuthorizedException - the requesting user is not authorized to issue this request.
